decisions.reason: Actual returned image compared to exact original on immutable alpha contact page. The smile is now correctly restored, but the mascot head still continues into a long tapered yellow throat/chest column wedged into the human-sized open V collar. Redraw a compact near-round head with an actual curved chin, very short broad neck transition and shoulders adapted to the mascot at the original neckline. Keep the shirt V genuinely open and exposed yellow upper chest where appropriate; do not close it, add a cream bib/undershirt, or leave a long narrow yellow stalk below the mouth. Preserve the successfully restored real tooth-showing smile, actual curly brown hair, smooth face, olive open shirt, source pose/lighting/crop and restored opaque painted backdrop.
